actual_scope: Determine the coefficient denominators and precision required for optimal noise amplification among all exact left inverses of the normalized full four-qubit Clifford tensor map.
scope_change_reason: The #7792 obstruction concerns one canonical inverse. The new problem concerns the best possible norm among all exact left inverses and all coefficient grids.
bottleneck_link: Quantifies unavoidable coefficient precision under a Euclidean perturbation model at every full-rank width. A physical realization would require an additional implementation and tape invoice.
stop_rule: Prove an attainable odd-denominator criterion, derive matching precision exponents, and certify the minimum-eigenvalue input and the neutral-sector transfer.

open_questions.question: What is the least common odd denominator of the canonical matrix itself at width 13?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The optimal denominator over all minimizers does not settle the canonical choice.
open_questions.first_step: Analyze all 52 spectral levels together and track the denominators of their projections.
open_questions.blocked_by: Their arithmetic interaction is not determined by the least eigenspace alone.

open_questions.question: At width 13, what denominator power of two suffices for a specified excess noise tolerance with a realizable decoder?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The sharp fixed-matrix exponent leaves large constants and does not give a practicable decoder.
open_questions.first_step: Bound the projection norm for a specified implicit splitting and give a precision budget for one concrete tolerance.
open_questions.blocked_by: The current upper construction rounds a full matrix and has no compressed implementation bound.
